title: Search within a file
summary: Find locates matching text in the current file. Check match-case and whole-word settings when results seem surprising.
introduction: Find locates matching text in the current file. Check match-case and whole-word settings when results seem surprising. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Find locates matching text in the current file. Check match-case and whole-word settings when results seem surprising.

blocks.code:

Search: moon
Match case on: lowercase matches only
Whole word on: excludes moonlight

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Predict the matches with both options on.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.text: An empty result can come from a filter, not from missing text.
